programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​探索由社區經營的瑞特提大象庇護所,在這裡,人類的代理媽媽們透過玩耍教導小象如何在野外生存,並細心地照顧與陪伴牠們成長。與那隻失去象鼻的小象隆烏洛建立情感連結,同時了解為什麼六歲的小象凱勒勒那場神祕的疾病,可能會讓牠的重返野外之路被迫延遲。

programme.title: 成為大象: 瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻。歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員: 一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安。

programme.title: 空中翱翔 #4
programme.desc: 看動物穿越天空展開非凡的旅程。穿梭在木製迷宮中的迅捷蒼鷹,加入沙雞艱辛遠行到遙遠水源的跋涉,並觀賞一群椋鳥形成的壯觀集體盤旋,迷惑牠們的天敵。

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #2 英普
programme.desc: 散落在不同海洋上的島嶼,其多樣性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前發生。從加拉帕戈斯群島走到南極洲,看看海獅、雀鳥、蟋蟀、猴子和其他野生動物,如何以驚人的適應力來應對氣候變化問題。

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #3 英普
programme.desc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存。與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難、看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小。

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #4 英普
programme.desc: 前往美國極北地帶,拜訪沿著水道生活的終極格鬥士。春回大地,看到融雪就知道格鬥隨時上演: 鷹與鷺的對決、熊族對陣,以及蜻蜓蛹與大型水蟲之間的決鬥。

programme.title: 野獸絕地求生記 #5 英普
programme.desc: 跟隨麥可斯探索斯里蘭卡,窺探懶熊常被誤解的神秘世界。見證這種看似人畜無害、毛髮蓬亂的動物,如何無畏地擊退豹子,並觀察牠們如何努力獲取所需的營養。

programme.desc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地。年輕的鯨魚、海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #2
programme.desc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #3
programme.desc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #4
programme.desc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反。在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓。對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #2
programme.desc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #3
programme.desc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #3
programme.desc: 阿拉斯加已進入夏季。這為世上最大規模之一的阿拉斯加三文魚遷徙準備了舞台。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #4
programme.desc: 座頭鯨回歸阿拉斯加豐饒的食堂,三文魚則回到河流產卵。不過,牠們必須跟飢餓的棕熊討一條生路。

programme.title: 下一站: 緬甸
programme.desc: 《下一站: 緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美、最壯觀的「亞洲遺產」濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #3
programme.desc: 文拿探索他加拿大的「後院」,發現美味的素壽司、開心果奶油甜餡煎餅捲和薄餅;他與喜劇演員巴森尤瑟夫一起在一家素芝士廠試工。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #4
programme.desc: 文拿在梅斯卡酒和香料的狂熱中,品嚐了許多當地美食: 素海鮮、檸檬汁「海鮮」冷盤和經典的素食辣醬粟米餅。之後,文拿跟一位當地的奶奶製作傳統的混醬。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #5
programme.desc: 德州中心深處是一片素食綠洲;文拿探索另類令人驚喜的德州美味素食: 炸雞、巨大无比的餅乾、排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #3
programme.desc: 巴拉克歐巴馬是首位非裔美國總統,體現了希望、正義、寬容和平等,以他的信息和傳承啟發數百萬人。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #4
programme.desc: 探索比爾柯林頓複雜的影響,從阿肯色州起家到白宮的高山(經濟繁榮)與低谷(醜聞、彈劾),以及他對美國政治的影響。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #5
programme.desc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭、其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡。

programme.title: 重塑: 瑪麗蓮·夢露 #4
programme.desc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞。

programme.title: 碧昂絲: 鄉村音樂女王
programme.desc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合「天命真女」主唱到現在的單飛生涯。探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的。

programme.title: 夏奇拉: 新時代女性
programme.desc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣。

programme.title: 基努李維: 獨一無二
programme.desc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月、多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在。

programme.title: 強尼戴普: 蛻變的藝術
programme.desc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員、製片人與���樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名。儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞台上迎來強勢回歸。

programme.title: 喬治克隆尼: 倡導者
programme.desc: 喬治・克隆尼以迷人外型與自然魅力聞名,但他的傳奇不僅止於銀幕。娛樂之外,他更是慈善與人道精神的代表人物。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #5
programme.desc: 本紀錄片審視喬治小布希的總統任期,尤其是伊拉克戰爭、其後遺症以及他的決定帶來的持久影響,包括伊斯蘭國的崛起和衝突造成的傷亡。

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #6
programme.desc: 朗奴雷根是一位有魅力的領袖,他用列根經濟學將美國轉營,在國內外有著不同意見,又用他富有遠見的政策和標誌性的演講永遠改變保守主義。

programme.title: 亞瑟: 皇家生活
programme.desc: 亞瑟在四十多年來拍攝主要王室成員的照片,不僅與他們建立了工作關係,並跟國王查爾斯三世和王后成了朋友。

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #5
programme.desc: 要觀察這片充滿地質現象的土地,只能從高空欣賞其雄偉的真面貌。從散佈在海岸線上被遺忘的沉船到卡奧科蘭無解的仙女圈,納米比亞的秘密將被揭開。

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #6
programme.desc: 在豐富多彩的非洲國家-尚比亞上空翱翔。包括世上最富有的人所打造的城市和擠滿世上最貧窮的人的市場。

programme.title: 重塑: 瑪麗蓮·夢露 #4
programme.desc: 本集探索瑪麗蓮如何展現她成熟的演員天賦,還有紅顏薄命的她剛戰勝二十世紀霍士就香消玉殞。

programme.desc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合「天命真女」主唱到現在的單飛生涯。探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的。

programme.title: 夏奇拉: 新時代女性
programme.desc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣。

programme.title: 基努李維: 獨一無二
programme.desc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月、多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在。

programme.title: 強尼戴普: 蛻變的藝術
programme.desc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員、製片人與音樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名。儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞台上迎來強勢回歸。

programme.title: 喬治克隆尼: 倡導者
programme.desc: 喬治・克隆尼以迷人外型與自然魅力聞名,但他的傳奇不僅止於銀幕。娛樂之外,他更是慈善與人道精神的代表人物。

programme.title: 基努李維: 獨一無二
programme.desc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月、多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在。

programme.title: 強尼戴普: 蛻變的藝術
programme.desc: 強尼・戴普是美國演員、製片人與音樂人,以多元電影角色與動盪的個人生活聞名。儘管歷經挫折,他依然持續活躍於藝術領域,並在國際舞台上迎來強勢回歸。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #5
programme.desc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想。茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然。例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #6
programme.desc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯。來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事。是時候告別韋札的家人。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 大西洋 #1
programme.desc: 探索大西洋的荒野和野生動物。冬天帶來嚴苛的風暴、苦難和衝突,大多數動物都要為生存而戰。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 大西洋 #2
programme.desc: 在冬天的尾巴,大西洋再度生機盎然。在深海水域過冬的魚群再度回歸。一對老鷹在完美捕魚點的高空築巢。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #5
programme.desc: 德州中心深處是一片素食綠洲;文拿探索另類令人驚喜的德州美味素食: 炸雞、巨大无比的餅乾、排骨包和垂涎欲滴的素牛腩。

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #6
programme.desc: 文拿回鄉與饒舌歌手海特什夏爾馬一起製作素雪糕,然後繞回家品嚐媽媽做的埃及菜。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #1
programme.desc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味。他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #2
programme.desc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒。他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #2
programme.desc: 按時序再體驗太陽神13號險些釀成的災難,這是美國太空總署同時最具破壞性和最美好的時刻之一。通過新聞片段、任務控制的音頻和美國太空總署的存檔見證1970年4月的事件。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #3
programme.desc: 通過警察的音頻和視頻,還有當地及國家新聞報道,審 視2002年華盛頓特區的狙擊手襲擊事件。狙擊手為期三週的恐怖統治引發了美國史上最激烈、最複雜的搜捕行動之一。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #4
programme.desc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #7
programme.desc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史。他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程。Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #1
programme.desc: 在聖露西亞,雙胞胎驚喜現身梅茜的度假之旅,帆船探險、叢林健行、極致享受的巧克力按摩、蘭姆酒品鑑,熱帶樂趣無限延伸!

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #2
programme.desc: 在冰島,邦妮與雙胞胎展開史詩冒險——賞鯨、火山健行、策馬奔馳,還有極光下的深度環保對話。

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #3
programme.desc: 在杜拜,路克全力挑戰腎上腺素極限: 潛水探險、水上飛行器、揮桿高爾夫、快艇狂飆——最後邊晚餐邊暢聊《哈利波特》回憶,輸家買單!

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #4
programme.desc: 在波蘭,蘇菲拋下寧靜假期,換來滿滿刺激: 征服壯麗塔特拉山、漂流急湍河道、探訪傳奇鹽礦,精彩不間斷!

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #5
programme.desc: 在因斯布魯克,雙胞胎帶海莉闖入阿爾卑斯仙境,飛馳滑雪、雪車衝刺、盡情暢飲,重溫童星榮耀時刻——還有神秘魔法驚喜!

programme.title: 亞瑟: 皇家生活
programme.desc: 亞瑟在四十多年來拍攝主要王室成員的照片,不僅與他們建立了工作關係,並跟國王查爾斯三世和王后成了朋友。

programme.title: 威廉斯姊妹
programme.desc: 威廉斯姐妹。從沒有一個姓氏能與網球運動同義。與傷病、爭議和一躍成名的壓力鬥爭,很少運動員能說她們能取得威廉斯一樣的成就。從白紙般的青少年到經驗豐富的老兵,無人能預測出姐妹倆的職業生涯,或者她們又能嗎?

programme.title: 摩根費里曼: 打破障礙
programme.desc: 摩根費里曼是荷里活最知名的演員之一,以其有力的聲線和溫文的舉止見稱。儘管他的特質廣為人知,但真實的他卻不是眾所周知。

programme.title: 非洲的空中歷險 #6
programme.desc: 在豐富多彩的非洲國家-尚比亞上空翱翔。包括世上最富有的人所打造的城市和擠滿世上最貧窮的人的市場。

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #1
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機。這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣。第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #6
programme.desc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長、與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名。他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾。

programme.desc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史。他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #4
programme.desc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反。在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓。對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #1
programme.desc: 隨著日照越短、天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #2
programme.desc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #3
programme.desc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 加拿大 #4
programme.desc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反。在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓。對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #3
programme.desc: 蘆筍當造 - 班挑選3個品種。他遇到一位農民,瞭解到穀飼牛的好處。班追隨注重自耕蔬果的「土壤姐妹」運動。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #4
programme.desc: 班參觀可持續養殖的綠殼青口養殖場,又參觀花生醬工廠。他到坎特伯雷見一個鴕鳥農夫,並第一次烹煮鴕鳥!

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #5
programme.desc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師。班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務。

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #6
programme.desc: 班體驗製作芝士的藝術。他遇到一位甜椒生產商並瞭解洋蔥的起源。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #4
programme.desc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #5
programme.desc: 透過檔案錄像見證柯林頓總統被彈劾當天的故事。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #6
programme.desc: 見證美國南部和中西部如何在短短18小時內遭受148個龍捲風肆虐。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
programme.desc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂羅德里格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員。馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
programme.desc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾托森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築——從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
programme.desc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索——理解靈感為何而來。在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟。

programme.title: 博物館的祕密 3 #1
programme.desc: 《博物館的祕密》帶觀眾深入倫敦 VA 博物館幕後,展出康斯特勃的版畫、桑迪・鮑威爾的簽名西裝、法貝熱的英國作品,以及由首位 Beano 女性藝術家蘿拉・豪威爾創作的新漫畫插圖。

programme.title: 博物館的祕密 3 #2
programme.desc: 本週於 VA 展出: 一套為男裝展打造的粉紅亮片西裝、搬遷至東倫敦分館的羅賓漢花園十噸建築切片、青年館展示的仿生手臂,以及艾瑞克・拉維利斯的《旅行》茶具組。

programme.title: 博物館的祕密 3 #3
programme.desc: VA 的策展人挖掘物品背後的未知故事,包括非洲時尚、一塊肯特布料、一張詹姆斯・巴納攝影作品,以及一只令人困惑的「古波斯」餐盤。

programme.title: 摩根費里曼: 打破障礙
programme.desc: 摩根費里曼是荷里活最知名的演員之一,以其有力的聲線和溫文的舉止見稱。儘管他的特質廣為人知,但真實的他卻不是眾所周知。

programme.title: 惠妮休斯頓: 天籟背後
programme.desc: 一段震撼人心的旅程,深入描繪惠妮休斯頓如流星般崛起的人生——從福音音樂的根源到全球巨星的巔峰,揭開錯綜複雜的情感關係、與成癮搏鬥的陰影,以及那把曾無可動搖、最終令人心碎的嗓音,在她英年早逝前的起落沉浮。

programme.title: 席琳狄翁: 愛無止境
programme.desc: 席琳狄翁是家喻戶曉的名字,象徵著無與倫比的音樂才華。然而,她的人生並非一帆風順。跟隨我們一同揭開傳奇背後的故事——從聲名鵲起的爆紅之路,到塑造她非凡事業的個人考驗。

programme.desc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機。這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣。第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器。

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #2
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機。這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣。第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器。

programme.title: 加密貨幣大解密 #2
programme.desc: 現在我們知道為何加密貨幣是何等大事,而我們在本集將認識紐西蘭最大的加密貨幣成功故事之一背後的家族。我們將破除一些加密神話並介紹如何參與的入門。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #6
programme.desc: 基努與加德遇見馬蒂羅德里格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人員。馬蒂與團隊探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何啟發我們的一切創造。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #7
programme.desc: 在挪威,前衛建築師謝提爾托森以顛覆性的思維重新定義建築——從可行走的歌劇院到沉入海中的餐廳,他的設計挑戰我們對空間的想像。

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #8
programme.desc: ARCH 的旅程是一場關於好奇心的探索——理解靈感為何而來。在拜訪世界各地的創意先鋒後,基努與加德回到 ARCH,回顧一路上獲得的啟發與體悟。

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.title: 太空使命 #2
programme.desc: 隨著太空競賽愈演愈烈,沃納·馮·布勞恩局長因反對尼克森總統關於NASA未來發展的指令而陷入困境。同時,心懷不滿的鮑德溫面臨重返原職的艱難抉擇,但代價是巨大的道德風險。此外,特蕾西·史蒂文斯在丈夫出軌的打擊下瀕臨崩潰,她甚至考慮採取極端措施。

programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#81粵
programme.desc: 溢在夢中見己化身成孫悟空，更替「唐僧」義打走蜘蛛精。有遇上前任女友，有「蜘蛛精」之稱的智貞來訪。她更向義重提結婚協議。溢與義用盡辦法也不能打消貞的求愛念頭，時溢引發意外，令貞損失億元生意，貞揚言報復。

programme.title: 尚食#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 錦衣衛查明與刺客接頭的中間人是曾跟隨瞻基習武的幼軍士兵，皇上起了疑心，遂派瞻基去南京。子衿讓瞻基施以苦肉計，同時利用這機會假裝不經意盛讚皇上聖明，再大膽進言為建文朝逆臣家眷求情，受皇上賞識，升任司膳。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 阿譚品嚐台式滷水小食後仍然「未夠喉」，鼎爺應拍檔要求帶來更多台式滋味。台式刈包又名「虎咬豬」，從搓麵糰到發酵等步驟，有甚麼要訣？自家製滷肉採用多種調味料，除了撈飯一流，用刈包夾起享用，同樣美味！有機農場內種植了巨型冬瓜，鼎爺分享揀選冬瓜小貼士，還會教煮味道濃郁、消暑補氣的「冬瓜粒鴨湯」。將冬瓜打泥，加入片糖慢慢煮勻成冬瓜糖之後，便可隨時加水煲出「冬瓜茶」。自製冬瓜糖雖然做法不難，但講求時間與耐性！

programme.title: 滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 眼睛血管阻塞或會引致「眼中風」，眼科醫生提醒年紀較大、三高人士、吸煙者是風險較高族群，病徵為突發視力模糊。這病現時以黃斑針治療為主，醫生亦詳述此針劑的相關資訊與注意事項。心肌肥厚最常見由高血壓形成，有機會導致患者出現心律問題，甚至猝死，不容忽視！心臟科醫生細說診治資訊，並提醒大眾如出現心悸、胸悶等徵兆，應及早求醫。「睇餸食飯」環節，小儀師傅示範一道「沙茶牛頸脊粉絲煲」，香濃惹味。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 糖尿病是中老年人常見病症之一，近年更有年輕化的跡象，情況值得關注。《醫度講》這集請來馮盈盈，由於其母親有輕微糖尿，令她對糖尿病亦十分關心。本集有胡依諾醫生為大家解構何謂「糖尿病」與箇中的分類，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會跟大家分享糖尿病的食療。

programme.title: 五味人生#13粵
programme.desc: 飛揚與婉君參觀義學，驚見勝天與金鳳擁抱。永禎特意製造機會給九妹向雙春表白卻失敗。飛揚決定派永禎前往婆羅乃開分公司，永禎、雙春和九妹月下喝酒，細數昔日趣事……永禎私下安排相士說出雙春與九妹登對，相士卻說永禎與雙春有夫妻相。若嵐突然提出要與永禎私奔，硬塞火車票給他；永禎在出發前與勝天往省城遊玩，勝天竟受襲；飛揚夫婦趕抵得知是永禎救回兒子，永禎出差之事暫且擱置。永禎發現若嵐交給自己的車票竟是廿年前的……

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 機械舞(Popping)與甩手舞(Waacking) 同屬主流街舞，「Kids’ Notes」邀來兩位舞者兼導師，介紹舞種特色並即場示範，當中更包含米高積遜的經典滑步(Slide)。兩位嘉賓分享緣何開展跳舞之旅，女舞者更提到成功透過舞蹈瘦身。舞蹈中展現個人風格有助令觀眾留下印象，嘉賓們是如何尋找個人風格？二人認為香港舞者創意十足，善於在有限資源下發揮所長，並寄語有意學舞的小朋友可多嘗試不同舞蹈。

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 五十嵐率先挑戰球洞，但失敗收場。蜻蛉用奇招成功破解球洞，垢多不服，要求她用正統打法再試一次，作為兩人之間的認真較量。蜻蛉挑戰成功，垢多卻指出她現時的打法在競技世界行不通。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
programme.desc: 康城一個新盤單位，發現牆身空鼓及露台積水，發展商執修後，能否解決問題？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 渣打香港呈獻：財富之道粵
programme.desc: 有車主誤以為「易通行」推出後，會沿用自動扣費方式繳付隧道費，收到逾百倍罰款通知亦認定是詐騙，遲遲沒理會，最後被罰款達一萬元？AI換臉技術成為騙徒的犯案手段，林以諾牧師被改圖「艷照」勒索，希望藉公開事件提醒公眾小心。事主搬入租住單位，疑因拜地主與焚香習慣引鄰居不滿，被對方燒符詛咒、在門口噴殺蟲水等滋擾，就連女兒也無辜受波及……鄰居直認行為激進，卻指事主違反大廈公契在先？另帶來關於理財與退休規劃資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2791粵
programme.desc: 大四喜與雷公相爭，欲提升「人氣」，家聰提議大四喜與力王、群姐合作。力王因不想分心唱歌而推託，敢佳卻發現網上有他與群姐合唱的新MV。原來群姐因某些原因利用AI生成影片，並被人上載網絡。力王堅決不肯合唱，敢威遂找Ivan以AI代勞。大四喜、群姐與AI力王的合唱MV大受歡迎，力王以侵權為由要求影片下架卻不果，聲言要提控敢威，父子不歡而散。敢威本欲與力王和好，怎料力王竟將事情鬧大，敢威遂決意與他「相鬥」……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#18粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知的存疑揭出犯案真相，邵玲自覺辜負雅文而愧疚，惠知的說話，讓她回顧童年與母親的關係。邵文憶起跟雅晴的甜蜜點滴，才意識已動真情，並向她道歉，但雅晴只願做回朋友。郊野發現一焦屍，四名少年被捕。惠知懷疑是謀殺，惟屍體損毀嚴重，無法證實死因，只能控以非法處理屍體罪。案件開審，控方錯漏百出，讓辯方淑樺有機可乘，提出釋放被告之一張景翔。惠知態度強硬，拒絕淑樺要求……惠知為審案選擇延後手術，令案件產生變數……

programme.title: 大生意人#13粵普PG
programme.desc: 喬松把投誠義軍暫時安置到北營，但入夜後卻殺死他們，平原覺得是自己害死他們，而李成和依梅被生擒活捉；平原求紫軒幫忙去找九帥，只有九帥能把李成和依梅救出來；李成勸義軍不要再打仗，說完這番話就拔劍自刎而死。

programme.title: 試真D粵PG
programme.desc: 有恐懼就要面對！GM自言一直怕蟲，廣州有餐廳提供「多蟲」選擇，每當蟲蟲上枱，GM都似乎想把菜式移開！一隻「身價高」的桂花蟬，何以令他反應奇大？朱仔亦因某乳鴿店老闆娘的凌厲眼神而恐懼，據指有湯店女店主是練習吵架的好對手，朱仔能否藉這趟探店撫平創傷？經過了解，湯店老闆娘「有性格」，原來出於顧及食物衛生的苦衷。美儀姐往找醫師把脈，其實是為了一個專屬火鍋湯底。「菇有菇味」食評絕非講笑，更值得給予店家滿分！

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#11粵PG
programme.desc: 簡潔收拾心情重投工作。國棟知文靜與家聰準備離港，到機場找二人，甫見家聰，即怒打他一場，文靜維護家聰並向國棟承認早已變心，國棟傷心。時楊光看見一切，國棟要楊光將事件保密。國棟悲痛下找家中各人發洩，妹國寶、弟國樑及兄國富均為目標。國棟寄情工作，遂命下屬加緊整理未完的工作，各人均吃不消。國棟與文靜離婚的消息，瞬間傳遍整個差館，國棟以為是楊光所為。楊光將首次談判成功的經歷，傳送上談判小組網頁與組員分享。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 有車主誤以為「易通行」推出後，會沿用自動扣費方式繳付隧道費，收到逾百倍罰款通知亦認定是詐騙，遲遲沒理會，最後被罰款達一萬元？AI換臉技術成為騙徒的犯案手段，林以諾牧師被改圖「艷照」勒索，希望藉公開事件提醒公眾小心。事主搬入租住單位，疑因拜地主與焚香習慣引鄰居不滿，被對方燒符詛咒、在門口噴殺蟲水等滋擾，就連女兒也無辜受波及……鄰居直認行為激進，卻指事主違反大廈公契在先？另帶來關於理財與退休規劃資訊。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 眼睛血管阻塞或會引致「眼中風」，眼科醫生提醒年紀較大、三高人士、吸煙者是風險較高族群，病徵為突發視力模糊。這病現時以黃斑針治療為主，醫生亦詳述此針劑的相關資訊與注意事項。心肌肥厚最常見由高血壓形成，有機會導致患者出現心律問題，甚至猝死，不容忽視！心臟科醫生細說診治資訊，並提醒大眾如出現心悸、胸悶等徵兆，應及早求醫。「睇餸食飯」環節，小儀師傅示範一道「沙茶牛頸脊粉絲煲」，香濃惹味。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 糖尿病是中老年人常見病症之一，近年更有年輕化的跡象，情況值得關注。《醫度講》這集請來馮盈盈，由於其母親有輕微糖尿，令她對糖尿病亦十分關心。本集有胡依諾醫生為大家解構何謂「糖尿病」與箇中的分類，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會跟大家分享糖尿病的食療。

programme.title: 五味人生#13粵
programme.desc: 飛揚與婉君參觀義學，驚見勝天與金鳳擁抱。永禎特意製造機會給九妹向雙春表白卻失敗。飛揚決定派永禎前往婆羅乃開分公司，永禎、雙春和九妹月下喝酒，細數昔日趣事……永禎私下安排相士說出雙春與九妹登對，相士卻說永禎與雙春有夫妻相。若嵐突然提出要與永禎私奔，硬塞火車票給他；永禎在出發前與勝天往省城遊玩，勝天竟受襲；飛揚夫婦趕抵得知是永禎救回兒子，永禎出差之事暫且擱置。永禎發現若嵐交給自己的車票竟是廿年前的……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#81粵
programme.desc: 溢在夢中見己化身成孫悟空，更替「唐僧」義打走蜘蛛精。有遇上前任女友，有「蜘蛛精」之稱的智貞來訪。她更向義重提結婚協議。溢與義用盡辦法也不能打消貞的求愛念頭，時溢引發意外，令貞損失億元生意，貞揚言報復。

programme.title: 尚食#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 錦衣衛查明與刺客接頭的中間人是曾跟隨瞻基習武的幼軍士兵，皇上起了疑心，遂派瞻基去南京。子衿讓瞻基施以苦肉計，同時利用這機會假裝不經意盛讚皇上聖明，再大膽進言為建文朝逆臣家眷求情，受皇上賞識，升任司膳。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 關菊英「包」下整集節目，連環放送<過客、<狂潮等首本名曲，一解歌迷相思之苦。她還分別與汪明荃、鄭少秋、馬浚偉組成「英明」、「秋菊」、「英浚」組合，炮製視聽盛宴；老拍檔伍衛國也「俾面」捧場。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#82粵
programme.desc: 溢看到滿身血跡的義和拿刀的智貞，欲救人時卻滑倒地上。溢醒過來後竟「時光倒流」，他以為是上天給他拯救家人的機會。可惜幾番努力仍不得要領，反令貞認定溢來作弄她，貞怒極詛咒高家眾人要死！溢欲將家人強留在家。

programme.title: 尚食#22粵普
programme.desc: 子衿為躲避彭城伯夫人逃到書房，瞻基一邊為她掩護，一邊諷刺她機心重。皇上進食時突感不適，太子妃質疑八珍糕有問題，子衿冷靜地解釋。皇上欣賞子衿的聰慧，正要獎賞，皇后突然言明子衿的身分，提議冊封她為太子嬪。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 阿譚不吝嗇地拿出A5和牛，並分享正確的解凍步驟。阿爺卻選用水晶梨與甜豆，再以中式方法烹調和牛？和牛油脂多，炒煮時仍要加少許油，有何原因？鼎爺豪氣地用兩斤雞項，炮製更濃味的「豆豉雞煲」回敬阿譚。豆豉預先炸過不易溶化，而整個過程不加水，上枱前還有灒酒一步，滋味更濃！二人到唐餅店見識皮蛋酥的工序後，回到廚房自製「酥脆蛋散」。很多食物都是熱食才美味，蛋散卻不宜趁熱品嚐；而麵糰的搓揉及發酵時間亦要好好掌握。

programme.title: 渣打香港呈獻：財富之道粵
programme.desc: 《渣打香港呈獻：財富之道》，每集邀請各界精英與銀行專家，在輕鬆氛圍下暢談財富投資熱話，包括財富管理、AI投資、利率走勢、醫療保險及多元資產配置。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 醫學上縱無法根治柏金遜症，但可減慢病情惡化。神經科醫生細說此症成因與病徵，也會概述臨床診斷方法。早期柏金遜症患者，可按不同症狀服用對應藥物，晚期患者又可怎樣治療？兩位肝癌康復者到來受訪，提到接受肝臟移植手術後仿如「重生」，並加入相關義工團體，向同路人分享經驗。此外，團體每年舉辦名為「重生盃」的羽毛球比賽，推廣器官捐贈。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨炮製一道「新鮮菠蘿炒飯」，菠蘿要新鮮，再加海鮮夠美味！

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 高血壓是常見健康問題之一，本港15歲或以上人士約兩成七患有高血壓，而75歲或以上患高血壓的比率超過七成三，情況值得關注。這次請來對高血壓十分關心的支嚳儀，本集亦有胡依諾醫生為大家解構高血壓問題，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會在節目中跟大家分享高血壓的食療與降壓穴位。

programme.title: 五味人生#14粵PG
programme.desc: 若嵐被永禎嚇暈，醒後回復所有記憶；但無法想通雙春為何不離開，反而苦苦支撐酒樓及關家。飛揚要九妹煮出五碟同樣的菜式，指當中暗藏一個課題。九妹請眾人幫忙，雙春讓九妹明白自己的味覺出現問題，只得請雙春陪他求醫……雙春在發悶氣，永禎向她坦言說出九暗戀她。勝天把戲票連汽車及保鏢也借給永禎「會佳人」，永禎卻被誤認是勝天而遭綁架；飛揚竟決定不付贖金。雙春與九妹與綁匪見面，希望他們釋放永禎，九妹與對方大打出手……

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之海底探險隊粵普
programme.desc: 大海對孩子們來說總有著無限的吸引力，海底深處到底是什麼樣的？存活著哪些動物？它們的生存本領是什麼？一支神秘的海底探險隊正在悄悄集結，將帶著各種各樣的問題去海洋裡尋找答案。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 為了幫助大家強化心肺功能，兒童體適能教練於「WORKOUT 2GETHER」教做碎步跑、抬腿，再繞着地下的飛碟跑圈，然後邊走邊跳。喘氣反應實屬正常，最後以伸展動作完成整套鍛練，舒展一下肌肉。第二輪的訓練則針對手眼協調及平衡力，拋高豆袋，專注留意豆袋的動向去接住，再加上拍手、二人拋接等元素，難度與趣味大增。嘗試將豆袋放於頭頂，眼望前方走動，也可考驗平衡力。另播放《河馬與小鳥》的AI生成動畫下半部。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 第五次偶像公主大賽突然拍板舉行。假若Quartet STAR勝出，就能救回阿紡，但假若由暗黑千依勝出，Quartet STAR就會跟阿紡一樣被囚禁。面對這個危險的對決，阿櫻四人仍然態度堅決，令陽葵很想知道她們強大的秘密。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 香港的豬場數目，由七十年代的四千多戶，不斷縮減，直至現在只餘下四十多個，本地養豬業，是否走向末路呢？新聞掏寶和大家重溫2005年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵
滙豐保險呈獻 :準備退休有乜計粵
programme.desc: 退休是一段嶄新的人生篇章，值得細心規劃與期待。若可提前安排好財務、健康、生活的方向，便能於退休後真正享受自在和安穩。王祖藍、李亞男這對演藝圈的模範夫婦，引領觀眾從不同方面切入，認知退休所需準備，務求可在財務與生活規劃上更周全，得以輕鬆迎接屬於自己的人生新階段。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2792粵
programme.desc: 吳旺達贊助拍攝短劇，期間生出事端，Bonnie為救城安甘代其受罰，幸此時遇到嫻姐，獲她出面調解。Bonnie將與蔥頭之母會面，本憂心她難相處，及後知悉對方是嫻姐，便感鬆一口氣。嫻姐卻提出要Bonnie與蔥頭分手，原來嫻姐認為她與城安糾纏不清。城安後來在片場遇到嫻姐，本欲避嫌，但事與願違。城安為讓嫻姐相信他已與Bonnie撇清關係，付出不少努力，並因某人之故，事情越鬧越大，Bonnie卻發現不妥……

programme.title: 康業信貸快遞物業貸款呈獻：正義女神#19粵PG
programme.desc: 惠知向光正隱瞞病情，堅持完成審理「焦屍案」才接受手術。淑樺代表景翔，自信他可無罪獲釋。惟審訊期間，另一被告關勝輝轉為污點證人，供出景翔是團夥的首領……真相逐步揭出，惠知卻因病不支昏倒在庭上，案件轉由邵文接手審理。淑樺突然提出景翔的不在場證明，揭示他雖然就案發當日的行蹤說謊，但背後另有苦衷。最終，邵文以專業態度處理眼前證據，持平地審理案件……沒人想到，景翔有恃無恐，竟與網友一同策劃更瘋狂的遊戲。

programme.title: 大生意人#14粵普PG
programme.desc: 九帥要帶走李成的屍體，依梅情急之下昏倒，平原把依梅帶回家，但她一直昏迷不醒。胡老太爺著急地找平原幫忙，原來之前平原惹惱了萬堂，萬堂和外國茶商約定，一兩安徽茶都不許買，令安徽茶出口海外的銷路全部斷掉。

programme.title: 試真D粵

programme.title: 流行都市粵

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 高血壓是常見健康問題之一，本港15歲或以上人士約兩成七患有高血壓，而75歲或以上患高血壓的比率超過七成三，情況值得關注。這次請來對高血壓十分關心的支嚳儀，本集亦有胡依諾醫生為大家解構高血壓問題，而註冊中醫師何慧欣聯同營養師李澄琳，也會在節目中跟大家分享高血壓的食療與降壓穴位。

programme.title: 五味人生#14粵PG
programme.desc: 若嵐被永禎嚇暈，醒後回復所有記憶；但無法想通雙春為何不離開，反而苦苦支撐酒樓及關家。飛揚要九妹煮出五碟同樣的菜式，指當中暗藏一個課題。九妹請眾人幫忙，雙春讓九妹明白自己的味覺出現問題，只得請雙春陪他求醫……雙春在發悶氣，永禎向她坦言說出九暗戀她。勝天把戲票連汽車及保鏢也借給永禎「會佳人」，永禎卻被誤認是勝天而遭綁架；飛揚竟決定不付贖金。雙春與九妹與綁匪見面，希望他們釋放永禎，九妹與對方大打出手……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#82粵
programme.desc: 溢看到滿身血跡的義和拿刀的智貞，欲救人時卻滑倒地上。溢醒過來後竟「時光倒流」，他以為是上天給他拯救家人的機會。可惜幾番努力仍不得要領，反令貞認定溢來作弄她，貞怒極詛咒高家眾人要死！溢欲將家人強留在家。

programme.title: 尚食#22粵普

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵

programme.desc: 署名家明的人突然在全港所有媒體，刊登一份尋人啟事，相約「玫瑰」和他再續二十年前未了緣，眾人揭發玫瑰是麗。亨協助將麗「大變身」赴會。麗思前想後，認為應以最真一面見人，決意回復平日的打扮去見初戀情人家明。

programme.desc: 鼎爺親到本地蔗田揀靚竹蔗，再教大家煲「竹蔗茅根馬蹄飲」。香口蔗蝦令食指大動，鼎爺還特意將蔗切成扁平狀，以加入肥豬肉的蝦膠包住。想成品鬆化，在調製粉漿時需下點功夫。鼎爺再以原條黃鱔炮製「黃鱔焗飯」，飯熟後放上洗好的黃鱔焗熟，然後灒油及淋上煲仔飯豉油；醃黃鱔時加入生粉有何作用？將黃鱔起肉切絲，則可製作「銀芽肉絲炒鱔糊」，先將鱔絲醃香走油。烹調時如何減少銀芽出水？菜式上碟後，鼎爺在蒜上灒豬油，提升香味！

programme.desc: 熊家因故遭賊人洗劫一空，理應重新購置生活所需的設備，樹根卻堅決不肯。城安等人苦不堪言，遂分工購置家具及電器，試圖讓生活重回正軌，卻唯獨漏了「它」。「它」的功能已可被其他產品取替，眾人遂覺得「它」變得「可有可無」，但樹根缺少了「它」，卻感不習慣。尚善遂滿足樹根的需求，城安更提議將「它」升級。升級後的「它」有不少好處，但樹根仍感不滿，眾人本以為樹根只是不習慣，最終卻發現背後另有隱情……

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 鼎植口腔呈獻：齒中守護你粵
及時雨信貸呈獻：談判專家#13粵PG
programme.desc: 顧客何美嬌常到福記光顧而認識國富，美嬌須已婚，但仍引誘國富。可人藉與家全往海馬公園為借口，邀楊光同行。談判小組聚會中，國棟游說楊光復職遭拒。國棟隨即要求與楊光擲飛鏢勝負定去留，結果，楊光負，守諾留任談判小組。國棟見國寶畢業後無所事事，計劃送她往外國升學，國寶卻不願。國富與美嬌搭上，美嬌夫周志成得悉後，持刀大鬧福記斬傷國富，更脅持國寶。楊光到場與志成談判，國棟責楊光於過程中違反談判手則，楊光不認同。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 醫度講粵
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎是近年大疫情，持續數年，備受市民關注。《醫度講》這集請來朱智賢細述患上新冠肺炎的經過，並有陳佔耀醫生為大家解構新冠肺炎與「長新冠」問題。註冊中醫師何慧欣、營養師李澄琳也會在節目中跟大家分享治療及預防新冠肺炎的食療。

programme.title: 五味人生#15粵PG
programme.desc: 永禎與雙春逃走時不慎墮崖，雙春為救永禎身陷險境；永禎竟趁機向她表白……飛揚正欲讚賞九妹能練成將菜式的味道統一，九妹卻坦白說出自己的病情。鎮長與所長及鄉親到臨關家，提出將為雙春設立貞節牌坊；關老太眾人贊成，雙春沒法提反對……永禎通知雙春決定帶她離開佼佼鎮；但當冷靜下來，卻擔心雙春跟隨自己會變成騙子夫婦，要求九妹帶雙春離開。若嵐威迫利是妹供出雙春與人約會地點；更以大少奶身分要眾人助她捉姦……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#83粵
programme.desc: 署名家明的人突然在全港所有媒體，刊登一份尋人啟事，相約「玫瑰」和他再續二十年前未了緣，眾人揭發玫瑰是麗。亨協助將麗「大變身」赴會。麗思前想後，認為應以最真一面見人，決意回復平日的打扮去見初戀情人家明。

programme.title: 尚食#23粵普
programme.desc: 紫萍為子衿送膳，發現沒有妃嬪去拜會，她心裡不服氣；自瞻基向子衿送上禮物後，各宮娘娘看到子衿受寵，都到子衿的院裡爭先獻媚；瞻基親自向子衿送上同心鎖，坦誠對她的真心；皇后的壽誕上，後宮各人爭先向皇后送禮。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 手造皮鞋製作步驟繁複，黃耀英、黃建東請纓協助師傅造鞋，二人可會是「生蟲拐杖」？貨船上的「律囉」用作吊起貨物，亦撐起了四代木製品店的生計。律囉零件講求處處精準，製造過程更是「有規有矩」！歇後語「東莞臘腸－ 短肚闊封」，道出了廣東人機智靈巧的特質，這款特色臘腸還促成一段美滿良緣！粵劇團當然希望演出大收旺場，「爆棚」一詞原來叫人又喜又悲？另外，中文講師廖舜禧變身「生物教授」，揭開「好眉好貌生沙蝨」之謎。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 採用印度上乘檀香木製成的優質檀香扇，造工精緻且散發陣陣幽香。幸美被指「檀香木冚茅廁」，究竟怎麼一回事？郭師傅藉着拿手的雕刻工藝，為木製家品添上藝術美感；他在木板上刻字，當然不像主持般「木偶談戀愛－ 呆頭呆腦」！掌故專家鄭寶鴻提到昔日戲院觀眾喜歡「咬蔗」，還大談「揀蔗」心得，意欲何為？經過影視作品的傳講，金葉菊、梁天來成了悲慘人生的代名詞；大學講師廖舜禧亦會講解「豬頭丙」、「諸事喱」等趣怪人名起源。

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 機械城足球隊(完)
programme.desc: 每天放學後，機器人艾力都會和朋友們在森林公園的小足球場一起踢足球。有人內向，有人天才，有人愛搞怪，各式各樣的人集結成一支很棒的隊伍，展開一段熱血青春的足球故事。

programme.title: 夢怪護衛隊
programme.desc: 納喬和家人在一個夜晚搬進新城鎮，面對新家、新學校，一切都充滿未知的恐懼，而他的房間也藏著祕密：一群神秘又難以捉摸的怪物。但當噩夢來臨時，他們會成為最可靠的夥伴。

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 機械城足球隊(完)
programme.desc: 每天放學後，機器人艾力都會和朋友們在森林公園的小足球場一起踢足球。有人內向，有人天才，有人愛搞怪，各式各樣的人集結成一支很棒的隊伍，展開一段熱血青春的足球故事。

programme.title: 夢怪護衛隊
programme.desc: 納喬和家人在一個夜晚搬進新城鎮，面對新家、新學校，一切都充滿未知的恐懼，而他的房間也藏著祕密：一群神秘又難以捉摸的怪物。但當噩夢來臨時，他們會成為最可靠的夥伴。

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 夢怪護衛隊
programme.desc: 納喬和家人在一個夜晚搬進新城鎮，面對新家、新學校，一切都充滿未知的恐懼，而他的房間也藏著祕密：一群神秘又難以捉摸的怪物。但當噩夢來臨時，他們會成為最可靠的夥伴。

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.desc: 納喬和家人在一個夜晚搬進新城鎮，面對新家、新學校，一切都充滿未知的恐懼，而他的房間也藏著祕密：一群神秘又難以捉摸的怪物。但當噩夢來臨時，他們會成為最可靠的夥伴。

programme.title: 森林偵探
programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 人偶之家
programme.desc: 【丈夫經商失敗！崔明吉調包財閥孫女只為讓女兒入豪門】琴英淑是一位愛女心切的母親，性格溫厚，在丈夫生意失敗時，她也從不抱怨，自願到殷會長的家裡擔任管家。女兒京慧出生時便被診斷出心臟疾病，當時家境也很難提供好的醫療資源。在一場車禍中，她意外的將女兒京慧，與財閥孫女世妍互相掉包身分，本該是千金小姐的世妍也因此變為平凡人，在百貨擔任精品店職員，而京慧更是直接躍升為財團富三代，然而某一天世妍得知真相，發現原本屬於她的富貴人生全被京慧奪走，憤怒之下她改名換姓，決定拿回屬於她的一切。

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 【夫婦的世界「升級版」！初戀女神現身揭開五人幫隱藏面具】一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學「五人幫」維持二十年的體面假象。死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡。模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失。嫉妒的丈夫、被逼到絕境的妻子、病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 暖陽之下
programme.desc: 【溫馨陸劇/二寶＆事業該選誰？ 都市夫妻的兩難抉擇！】宋思凝懷著夢想隻身來到北京，經過多年打拼終於成為公司的人力總監，與創意公司總經理李俊龍成為夫妻，並育有一兒，日子過得幸福美滿。但在婚育觀上，兩人的想法有極大的分歧，經常為了女兒的教育問題爭吵，李俊龍希望能與思凝生育二寶，然而正值事業上升期的思凝，面臨自我實現與家庭的兩難衝突，在大都會生活的兩人又該如何抉擇呢？

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 先熱情地打掃吧(完)
programme.desc: 【《紅天機》金裕貞搭《玫瑰公寓》尹鈞相，上演元氣女與潔癖男的浪漫喜劇！！】立志消滅所有細菌，把清潔視為人類崇高使命，拒絕與他人肌膚接觸，無法忍受灰塵，經營清潔公司的潔癖執行長張善傑。遇上外表邋遢個性不拘小節的四次元少女吉五雪，畢業後的首份就業工作，努力完成員工清潔使命。極與極相遇的浪漫愛情喜劇。

programme.title: 君九齡
programme.desc: 九齡公主生性善良，喜好醫術，一場陰謀使得她失去至親，骨肉分離，容貌大變。為了查清真相報仇雪恨，九齡隱姓埋名一直蟄伏，靠著堅強的毅力和意志力，苦練技藝，不放過任何蛛絲馬跡，最終發現這場陰謀背後還有一段不為人知的皇室辛秘。知曉真相後的九齡，回到京城，在兇手不斷的騷擾和攻擊中建立了醫館九齡堂，濟世救人，受人尊崇。與此同時，朱瓚與清貴公子寧雲釗、前夫陸雲旗、方家獨子方承宇，身份各異、關係複雜的四人，陷入了以九齡為核心的感情漩渦。誰才是九齡的真命天子？

programme.title: 兩個人的小森林(完)
programme.desc: 虞書欣鎖定張彬彬，小太陽系女孩專治萬年冰山。戀愛正在發芽中！！】時尚美妝部落客虞美人，外表光鮮亮麗，卻始終放不下大學時期暗戀對象植物學教授莊羽。一次命運重逢，讓她決定重新展開追愛計畫。理性寡言的他，卻對這位熟悉又陌生的女孩逐漸敞開心扉。從城市學校到鄉村社會，從誤解到理解，在一片綠意中，共築屬於彼此的「小森林」，慢慢治癒、慢慢相愛。

programme.title: 請叫我總監
programme.desc: 【《錦心似玉》譚松韻、《楚喬傳》林更新，秘書與總裁的職場愛情喜劇！】寧檬的夢想是成為一位投資總監，畢業後實際工作卻與夢想越來越遠。上司陸既明是一位業務能力強大的投資總裁，也不認為寧檬會成功。下定決心離開的寧檬因緣際會進入鷹石投資重新開始。一直看著寧檬的陸既明，在每次重要關頭還是會拉他一把，幫助她度過難關，兩人的相處，隨著一次次的突發事件心靠得越來越近。

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Whale Watching
programme.desc: Bluey promises her customer, Bingo, the best tour ever in a game of Whale Watching, but they need Mum and Dad to join in, and they are too tired to play after a late night.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dad's accused of fluffing in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Cold
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po are outside in the cold when they spot the Tiddlytubbies who are warm, inside. The Teletubbies put on hats, gloves and scarves to keep warm.

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! (S1) - Safari Party
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing on safari.

programme.title: Pop Paper City (S1) - The Zip Express
programme.desc: The friends board the Zip Express, a train that takes them across Pop Paper City. But when the friends face an unexpected challenge, it's unknown if the train will reach their destination on time.

programme.title: Dog Loves Books (S1) - Dog Loves Fairytales
programme.desc: Dog loves books, and Dog especially loves books with fairytales in them. But this particular book of fairytales has an unlucky imp inside it.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Alien Television
programme.desc: Aliens on OKIDO telly? Skateboarders in the satellite?! Everything's upside down! It's up to Messy and his friends to fix it!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Comet
programme.desc: Messy has to save OKIDO from a falling comet before his bedtime! He sees that Mayor Oki still has his bath!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Pow Tao
programme.desc: Tao asks Mojo and Bo to help him film an action-packed snowboarding video, but Mojo is not so steady on the slopes. Which top can they swap to grab the white-hot snow shots?

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to put on a show
programme.desc: JoJo doesn't know what to do with her odd socks, so Gran Gran suggests they put on a puppet show! The two of them turn the socks into puppets, ready for a show in the garden.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Woolly Memories
programme.desc: Scarf Lady's old film reels get themselves in a tangle, so Sarah and Duck decide to recreate the footage.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Beach Break
programme.desc: Sarah &amp; Duck are spending a day at the beach, aiming to build some sand animals.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Gordon Gets the Giggles
programme.desc: Gordon becomes very worried when he gets a serious case of the giggles. He must find a way to control his laughter before it does any damage.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Shops
programme.desc: Playing 'Shops' is the best game ever for Bluey and her friends - if they can ever get started! With Bluey questioning the rules and changing who's who, they might be here all day!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Wagon Ride
programme.desc: Bluey can't wait to get to the monkey bars as Dad takes her and Bingo on a wagon ride to the park. But her patience is tested when Dad keeps stopping to chat with other grown-ups.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Taxi
programme.desc: Bluey is running a taxi service. Her first passenger is Businessman Dad, who is in a rush to get to the airport. But with unexpected delays, Dad's in danger of missing his flight!

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Spooky Day
programme.desc: Supertato runs in fright when Pumpkin tries to make friends with him, but later realises she needs his help as she's stuck in the air hanging from balloons set up by Evil Pea.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Choreography Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet Duggee's old dance crew and learn that he was kicked out because he couldn't stick to the choreography. The Squirrels are surprised because Duggee is such a good dancer!

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Pet Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a scruffelump in the woods, and despite Duggee's reservations, take him in. But they soon learn the responsibilities of taking care of a pet.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Lost Property Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels lose Tag in the Clubhouse but to find him they're going to have to figure out where the Lost Property room is.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Central Park, New York
programme.desc: Glitch visits Broadway, while the Go Jetters tackle a huge cloud of smog in Central Park.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Bullet Train, Japan
programme.desc: All aboard for a high-speed adventure, as the Go Jetters visit Japan's Bullet Train.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Go Jet Academy: Wind Power
programme.desc: The team race to save Glitch when his kite flies too close to the academy's windfarm.

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S2) - Mason's Yorkshire Puddings With Sausages
programme.desc: Mason is cooking a recipe named after the place it comes from: Yorkshire. Mason serves his recipe with broccoli, and lots of gravy.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures (S1) - Cassowary
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to the jungles of Australia in search of a cassowary. Along the way, they meet some wild budgerigars.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S7) - The Pirate Inspector
programme.desc: A mysterious Pirate Inspector is coming to visit Captain Captain and the pirates. If they fail the inspection, they will get a huge fine. But they soon suspect the Inspector is someone they know!

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Craft Book
programme.desc: Lily finds a flight-themed book that has instructions on how to make simple aircrafts.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Rug Island
programme.desc: On Bingo and Bluey's Rug Island, a pack of felt pens can be anything: bananas, campfires, even a snake. But Dad will need to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make it his home.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Charades
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nana must think quickly to keep the game on track.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Sticky Gecko
programme.desc: Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Walkie Talkie
programme.desc: The veggies are playing walkie-talkie hide-and-seek, but Evil Pea steals Carrot's walkie-talkie and uses it to trick the Veggies into getting trapped by the Corn Cobs.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: Roly reveals he's expecting a new baby brother or sister, and the Squirrels have questions.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancee enlists a swordsman-who secretly loves her-to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness & innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Men From The Monastery
programme.desc: At the end of the Ming Dynasty, Wu San Gui betrays his people to the Qing officials and recruits fighters from all backgrounds. Members from Wudan and Ermei are the first to yield and collude with local bullies. When they start attacking the Shaolin Monastery, its most famous disciples have to band together and fight against the enemies.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: Clan of Amazons
programme.desc: The martial arts world is plunged into terror when a mysterious figure known as the 'Embroidery Bandit' starts to attack convoys of precious materials. Seemingly unstoppable, the frightened clans decide to call on the expertise of Lu Xiao Feng, an inquisitive fighter and detective to capture the culprit.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage. A heartless tycoon plans to take over the orphanage for its land but has to deal with Seventh Sister's magical powers as she aims to protect it from falling into his hands!

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: This tale of a honorable fighter's retraining in the "Iron Palm" style, that became the first international martial arts movie hit and made a continent-spanning star of Lo Lieh.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Tie Zhong Tang, the adopted son of the Great Banner Sect leader, is hunted by the sect's rival for the secret to its hidden treasure. To uncover the truth, he journeys to an island seeking the "Empress of the Day", only to find her dead. There, he unexpectedly meets the sect's founder, the "Emperor of the Night", who reveals that he is Tie's biological father.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: Four Riders
programme.desc: Four martial arts experts live in Seoul after the Korean War in the 1950s. One of them inexplicably crosses path with a drug trafficking syndicate, and his three friends have no choice but to fight a brutal battle on his side...

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women's Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei's father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei's possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team's downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: When Chen Zhen studies in Japan, he finds several Chinese students missing and accidentally uncovers the Black Dragon Society's conspiracy. A new drug is invented to boost bodies of the Japanese troops in war and the Chinese students are used in their experiments. Chen Zhen vows to take down the evil society and destroy their secret laboratory.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: The legendary swordsman Li, entrusts the Green Destiny sword to a noble house for safekeeping. It is swiftly stolen by Yu, a young aristocrat of immense martial skills trained by an unscrupulous outlaw master. Recognising her talent, Li tries to guide her towards righteousness but ultimately leads them both to a tragic fate.

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Mister Mastodon
programme.desc: Po and team arrive in Guatemala and meet farmers who are facing a mysterious threat-- named The Protector, wielding the Storm Wheels. Elsewhere, Colin the Stag Knight and Weimin team up to go after Po and discover Mr. Ping's connection to the widely feared Pirate Queen.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S1 - Hide The Lightning
programme.desc: Po and team go to the city of Tikal to get more information on the Protector, but it's easier said than done, since nobody in the town actually knows the identity of the Protector. Blade becomes increasingly frustrated and Po attempts to help her.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Truth Be Told
programme.desc: During her last days on Earth, Aja decides to tell Steve the truth: she's an alien. But her plans are complicated when the Zerons abduct Aja, Steve and Krel. Meanwhile, Vex struggles with an impossible choice: saving the Royal teens or the Royal Cores.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Last Night on Earth
programme.desc: With the Mothership ready for liftoff, Aja and Krel celebrate their last day on Earth at Battle of the Bands. But their world is rocked when Zadra arrives with a startling revelation about Vex - and a new enemy threatens their departure.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Bad Omen
programme.desc: When Omen hijacks the Mothership and Royal Cores, all seems lost for our heroes. The Royal heirs are able to defeat the killer Blank, but at a high cost.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - Bumperdome Broaches
programme.desc: A near-accident gives Chet his first adrenaline rush, and in his quest for another he enters a dangerous race inside a pinball machine. The FAST team must work together to keep a group of sewer surfing roaches from entering the taco stand so that Tito can pass his health inspection.

programme.title: Turbo F.A.S.T. S1 - African Queen Mega Snails
programme.desc: The FAST crew is tricked into going to Africa by the Queen of the Banana Slugs for a dangerous journey through the plains in order to save her tribe. White Shadow is challenged by three over-zealous and over-sized championship sumo wrestler snails to an outrageous wrestling match.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - The Compst Elf Meet Ya at the Stump
programme.desc: The streets get trashy when Archibald misinforms folks about compost. Archibald and his pals rally when their favorite hangout is threatened.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Lost Space Rocket
programme.desc: Smartysaurus is going to launch into space in her all-new super space rocket. But as her friends all watch on the Daredale Big Screen, the picture suddenly goes dead! Noddy investigates to find out what happened to Smartysaurus.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Smartysaurus's Jet Pack
programme.desc: Smartysaurus is trying out her new jet pack, but she hasn't read the instructions before taking off and cannot control it properly. Noddy investigates to help her control it before things get too dangerous.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Topsy Turvy Trees
programme.desc: All is set for the Toy Green Picnic until Noddy finds some of the trees turned upside down! Was it the Ninjas climbing on them? Or the Pirates wanting an upside-down tree for Pirate Bay? Noddy launches an investigation to find out who's behind all this.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Golden Thing
programme.desc: The Knights have found a mysterious Golden Thing. But the Pirates insist it's their Golden Thing. Noddy tries to settle the argument by investigating: Who is the owner of the Golden Thing? He soon finds more and more Golden Things have been hidden all over Toyland.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Meerkat Is Always On The Look Out
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Meerkat was not always on the lookout. Meerkat used to race around Tinga Tinga bumping into things and causing chaos. She never stayed still long enough to listen to any beast. But then one day Meerkat bumps into the Sleeping Stones... and they make her listen alright! Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Cheetah Has Tears
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Cheetah didn't have tears. She was the fastest animal in the whole of Tinga Tinga. Cheetah was faster than even the Wind. Every year Cheetah and Wind would race to see who was the fastest and every year Cheetah would win. Until one day.... Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Zooming Zipwire
programme.desc: Ted and PC Selby are building a zipwire to run from Greendale Crag all the way down into the valley. The kids are on a hike, led by Lauren which is due to culminate at the zipwire - the only trouble is, it's not built yet! Pat and Jess have to race against time to deliver the huge steel cable to the top of the crag before the kids get there.

programme.title: Postman Pat: Special Delivery Service S3 - Postman Pat And The Super Jet Boots
programme.desc: Julian and the kids at Greendale School are excited about a Festival of flight - Ted's coming to talk about aviation and Alf's bringing Cedric the racing pigeon. Pat has to deliver special jet boots to the school, built by Ted's inventor friend. Ted will demonstrate them. But on the way to Greendale, Pat stops to help Alf, whose cows have got loose. Pat sees Ajay, out for a day's bird-watching.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - It's Go Go Go At Silver Hatch
programme.desc: Murray Walker is visiting Silver Hatch. Mr Carburettor would like him to commentate while the cars put on a stunt display. But Murray has other ideas… he admits he has always dreamed of racing himself. An unlikely candidate makes his dreams come true!

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Silver Hatch Heroes
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor's cousin Chubby is coming to Silver hatch as he wants to film his new blockbuster there. Everybody goes all out to prove that it is just the right location for Chubby's new film

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - PC Roary
programme.desc: Roary helps PC Pete keep the track safe on a snowy day.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Winter Breeze
programme.desc: Breeze is visiting the track. The beach is boring in the winter as nobody comes to visit. She tries her best to help everyone get ready for the winter festival but doesn't seem to be good at anything…

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Upset Captain
programme.desc: Pirate Captain says he doesn't want to be the captain anymore. Noddy investigates how they can help him and he soon finds the reason for the Captain's distress: someone took his beard! Noddy sets out in search of the missing beard.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of Revs & Tractor
programme.desc: Revs and Tractor are doing Tom's deliveries together, but only Tractor comes back. Why isn't Revs with Tractor? Tractor is too upset to explain what happened, so Noddy investigates to find his friend.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Toyland Circus
programme.desc: It's the Toyland Circus and all the toys are rehearsing an act - all except Smartysaurus, who rushes away, apparently too shy to take part. Noddy has to find a way to help Smartysaurus find an act for the circus.

programme.title: Noddy Toyland Detective S2 - The Case Of The Deltoid's Missing Strength
programme.desc: Action-hero Deltoid suddenly loses all his strength and finds himself totally helpless. Noddy quickly starts an investigation: How can he help Deltoid get his strength back?

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Doodlebook
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a cup of crayons and a coloring book with the same doodle on every page. When she takes it into The dollhouse each of the Gabby Cats sees something different in the doodle and turns it into a uniquely magical drawing. But when CatRat gets stuck inside the book, Gabby and Pandy must go on a doodle rescue mission to save him.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Dollhouse Safari
programme.desc: It's time for a safari adventure in the dollhouse! Carlita, decked out like a safari truck, takes Gabby and Pandy on an adventure through the dollhouse as they follow clues to find the mysterious Felis Catus and discover all kinds of other dollhouse wildlife along the way! For the COTD segment, Cakey and Parrot show us how to make adorable safari snacks.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Home Alone
programme.desc: Aggro, Burple and Cutter are left alone in the roost to care for some dragon eggs, but a trio of tricky Slinkwings want those eggs for themselves.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Slobber Power
programme.desc: Cutter gets a chance to be a "mom" when a newly hatched dragon bonds with him, and they'll both be needed to get the others out of a tangled mess.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - The Big Sleep-Walk Of Course You Can
programme.desc: When Ian starts to sleepwalk around Harmony Harbor, TZG secretly guides him back to his own bed where he can continue sleeping safely. When Felicia wants to run an obstacle course for the first time but is afraid she’ll embarrass herself, TZG secretly boosts her confidence by helping with practice.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Secret Ingredient Delete That Dew!
programme.desc: When Harper is missing an ingredient to make her Mom’s favorite dessert on Mother’s Day, Eden enlists the help of her fellow Dew Drops to do an emergency city-wide ingredient search! When Marcus records a video of his inventions, Phoebe gets caught on camera and must erase the footage before Marcus sees, or her Dew Drop cover will be blown!
